description: Read a carousel board: revision, caption, pending AI images and a summary of every slide with its elements in paint order (ID, type, parent, text, image source, box in slide pixels, font, color, hidden, locked), plus the brand theme and saved themes. carousels_board_edit targets these IDs and theme ids. view full adds the board composition (editor element model; colors may be brand tokens like var(--br-accent); media sources are asset:<id>, brand:logo or bundled paths). slideIds limits the summary to those slides.

slideIds.description: Only these slides in the summary; null returns every slide

name: carousels_board_get
title: Get Carousel Board
